title: 2026–2027 Social Sciences Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor Stanford University
bio: Ayana Omilade Flewellen (they/she) is a Black feminist archaeologist, artist-scholar, and storyteller whose work moves between land and sea, past and present, archive and embodiment.
